scripts.typecheck: npm run build:contracts && ngc -p apps/web/tsconfig.app.json --noEmit && ngc -p apps/extension/tsconfig.app.json --noEmit && tsc -p apps/api/tsconfig.json --noEmit && tsc -p apps/reference-import/tsconfig.json --noEmit && tsc -p packages/tsconfig.json --noEmit
scripts.build: npm run build:contracts && ng build web && ng build extension && tsc -p apps/api/tsconfig.json && tsc -p apps/reference-import/tsconfig.json
scripts.lint: eslint apps packages tools tests && node tools/check-boundaries.mjs
scripts.test: npm run build:contracts && tsc -p apps/api/tsconfig.json && node --experimental-strip-types --test tests/*.test.mjs
scripts.ci: npm run lint && npm test && npm run typecheck && npm run build
scripts.test:oidc: npm run build:contracts && tsc -p apps/api/tsconfig.json && node tests/oidc.integration.mjs
scripts.test:sessions: npm run build:contracts && tsc -p apps/api/tsconfig.json && node --env-file-if-exists=.env tests/sessions.integration.mjs
scripts.test:handoff: npm run build:contracts && tsc -p apps/api/tsconfig.json && node tests/handoff.integration.mjs
scripts.test:operations: npm run build:contracts && tsc -p apps/api/tsconfig.json && node --env-file-if-exists=.env tests/operations.integration.mjs
scripts.test:payloads: npm run build:contracts && tsc -p apps/api/tsconfig.json && node --env-file-if-exists=.env tests/payloads.integration.mjs
scripts.test:budgets: npm run build:contracts && tsc -p apps/api/tsconfig.json && node --env-file-if-exists=.env tests/budgets.integration.mjs
scripts.test:recovery: npm run build:contracts && tsc -p apps/api/tsconfig.json && node --env-file-if-exists=.env tests/recovery.integration.mjs
scripts.test:language-regression: npm run build:contracts && tsc -p apps/api/tsconfig.json && node tools/run-language-regression.mjs
scripts.evaluation:plan: npm run build:contracts && tsc -p apps/api/tsconfig.json && node --env-file-if-exists=.env tools/run-real-language-evaluation.mjs
scripts.evaluation:run: npm run build:contracts && tsc -p apps/api/tsconfig.json && node --env-file-if-exists=.env tools/run-real-language-evaluation.mjs --execute
scripts.evaluation:signoff: npm run build:contracts && tsc -p apps/api/tsconfig.json && node --env-file-if-exists=.env tools/run-real-language-evaluation.mjs --signoff
scripts.evaluation:judge: npm run build:contracts && tsc -p apps/api/tsconfig.json && node --env-file-if-exists=.env tools/run-language-judge.mjs
scripts.test:editor-ui: ng build web && ng build extension && node tests/editor.browser.mjs
scripts.test:edge-package: npm run package:edge && KLARO_BROWSER=edge node tests/chrome-package.browser.mjs
scripts.test:edge-correction-e2e: npm run build && KLARO_BROWSER=edge node --env-file-if-exists=.env tests/correction.e2e.mjs
scripts.test:translation: npm run build:contracts && tsc -p apps/api/tsconfig.json && node --env-file-if-exists=.env tests/translation.integration.mjs
scripts.test:reference: npm run build:contracts && tsc -p apps/api/tsconfig.json && npm run build:reference && node --env-file-if-exists=.env tests/reference.integration.mjs
scripts.test:privacy: npm run build:contracts && tsc -p apps/api/tsconfig.json && npm run build:reference && node --test tests/proxy-privacy.integration.mjs && node --env-file-if-exists=.env tests/privacy.integration.mjs
